title: Sidebar
description: App navigation: a full-height rail at the inline start from the md breakpoint, and a top bar with a menu disclosure on phones.

props.name: Sidebar title
props.description: The product or workspace name at the top.

props.name: Sidebar label
props.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark.

props.name: Sidebar footer
props.description: Content pinned to the bottom of the rail, such as settings or the account.

props.name: SidebarGroup label
props.description: A visible group label; the group is announced with it.

props.name: SidebarItem active
props.description: Marks the current page with aria-current="page".

props.name: SidebarItem icon
props.description: A decorative icon; the link text stays the accessible name.

a11y: The links sit in a nav landmark named by `label`; the current page has aria-current="page".
Below 768px the menu button is a disclosure: aria-expanded and aria-controls, no focus trap, links stay in reading order.
Icons are aria-hidden; every link has visible text.
Start and end are logical, so the rail moves to the right in right-to-left layouts.
usage:
<Sidebar title="Studio">
  <SidebarGroup>
    <SidebarItem href="/" icon={<House />} active>Home</SidebarItem>
    <SidebarItem href="/inbox" icon={<Inbox />}>Inbox</SidebarItem>
  </SidebarGroup>
</Sidebar>
docs:
Installed `Sidebar`, `SidebarGroup` and `SidebarItem`. Import them from `@/components/ui/sidebar`.

Put `Sidebar` first in a flex row that fills the viewport (`flex h-dvh flex-col md:flex-row`): from 768px it is a rail at the inline start, below that a top bar with a menu button. Mark the current link with `active`.
